title: It leaks
text:
It leaks. THE PICTURE SHOWS A GREEN MACHINE MINE IS PURPLE. Model # 50Y6-W 12089C. Purchased 09-30-2012.
It leaked the first time I used it. Leaks where the hose comes out of the body. If you want to risk it and try one make sure you hang onto the reciept. Without it you just threw your money away. Purchased a spotbot in the past and it leaked out of the bottom where the bristles are. 2 Bissells struck out both times.

product_metadata.title: Bissell Little Green PROheat Deep Reach Spot Cleaner, Bright White, 50Y6
features: Powerful spot cleaning: strong spray and powerful vacuum suction to remove tough spots and stains
Hot water heater continuously heats hot tap water for MAXIMUM cleaning effectiveness
Long hose and power cord and compact design make cleaning hard-to-reach areas easy
Stores ready-to-use for quick clean-ups. For use on carpet, stairs, upholstery and even auto interiors
Deep Reach Tool sprays cleaning solution deeper into carpet fibers to clean from the bottom up
description: Bissell Little Green PROheat Deep Reach Spot Cleaner, 50Y6 - Have spots and stains on your carpet from pets, kids, or some other mystery source? No need to worry! With the help of Little Green you can spray, scrub and suction away even your toughest stains. Bissell is the only brand with a patented hot water heater, providing continuous heated cleaning by raising the temperature of hot tap water for Maximum cleaning effectiveness. And with Little Green’s compact design and long hose and power cord you can easily clean hard-to-reach areas on carpet, stairs, upholstery and even auto interiors. Use the Deep Reach tool for your toughest stains to clean to the bottom of the carpet fibers and the Tough Stain tool for quick spills and upholstery.
Deep Reach tool: Deep injection cones spray cleaning solution deeper into carpet fibers to clean from the bottom up.
